study.name: Study Planner
study.description: Plan reviews, assignments and exam prep alongside a copy of your classes.
study.seoTitle: Study Timetable Maker – Free Study Planner
study.seoDescription: Free study timetable maker. Plan reviews and assignments around your classes, set weekly hour goals per subject, auto-fill free slots and export your schedule.

exam.name: Exam Timetable
exam.description: Keep exam dates, times and locations together in a clear dated timetable.
exam.seoTitle: Exam Timetable Maker – Free Exam Schedule Planner
exam.seoDescription: Free exam timetable maker. Keep exam dates, times, rooms and seats in one agenda with countdowns and clash warnings. Export a PNG, print or add it to your calendar.

work.name: Work Schedule
work.description: Build your weekly shifts with clear times, locations and color-coded blocks.
work.seoTitle: Work Schedule Maker – Free Weekly Shift Planner
work.seoDescription: Free work schedule maker for weekly shifts. Set shift times, breaks and hourly rate, see weekly hours and overtime, then export a PNG, print or save to calendar.

daily.name: Daily Planner
daily.description: Give each part of your day a purpose with focused time blocks on a chosen date.
daily.seoTitle: Daily Timetable Maker – Free Daily Planner Online
daily.seoDescription: Free daily timetable maker. Time-block your day on a timeline, add a to-do list and top priorities, copy yesterday’s plan, and export a PNG or calendar file.

routine.name: Routine Planner
routine.description: Create a repeatable rhythm for mornings, workouts, meals and reading.
routine.seoTitle: Routine Timetable Maker – Free Daily Routine Planner
routine.seoDescription: Free routine timetable maker. Build a repeating weekly routine for mornings, workouts and reading, check off each day, track streaks and add it to your calendar.

custom.name: Custom Timetable
custom.description: Start with an open weekly canvas. Choose your events, hours, colors and title.
custom.seoTitle: Custom Timetable Maker – Blank Timetable Template
custom.seoDescription: Free custom timetable maker. Design a blank timetable with your own columns for days, rooms or people, pick a theme, then export a PNG, print or calendar file.
